title: the approval card shows exactly what

setup.note: One approval card for a WhatsApp send, with the recipient's name, the address the daemon will use, and the exact text.
setup.text: sending the villa advance tonight, sharing the receipt after

input_events: The card is read as a surface would render it.
It is tapped, minting the token.
The dispatcher is asked to send.

expected.card: recipient (name and address), channel and the verbatim text — nothing summarised
expected.on_edit: the minted token is revoked and the card drops back to pending
expected.after_edit: the send is refused until a new tap; the old token cannot carry the old text or the new one
expected.after_retap: exactly the edited text goes to exactly that recipient

wrong.label: edit-keeps-approval
wrong.assert_absent: an edited card sending on the token minted before the edit

wrong.label: card-hides-payload
wrong.assert_absent: an approval card that does not carry the recipient and the exact text it is authorizing

wrong.label: dispatcher-takes-caller-payload
wrong.assert_absent: the dispatcher sending a recipient or a body supplied by the caller instead of the card's own

source.section: GoldenEvals V6P1 §5.14 GATE-A-03 · the approval card shows exactly what
